newsitem.title: KENYA: Goma airport seized by fighters - U.N. official.
newsitem.headline: Goma airport seized by fighters - U.N. official.

text.p: Tutsi fighters seized on Thursday the airport in the eastern Zairean city of Goma, the centre for efforts to aid refugees in eastern Zaire, a U.N. spokesman said quoting the Zairean military.
"The airport has been taken over. It is confirmed from the Zairean side," U.N. High Commissioner for Refugees (UNHCR) spokesman Panos Moumtzis in the city of Goma told Reuters by telephone.
"Right now there is no movement in town. It is completely deserted," added Moumtzis, adding aid workers remained inside their offices in the lakeside city after heavy fighting since Thursday morning.
A Reuters correspondent in the Rwandan border town of Gisenyi said he could see fighting around Goma airport, five km (three miles) from the city centre, after Moumtzis said it had fallen.
An aid official earlier quoted the Zairean military as saying if necessary it would give up the airport to attackers.
